meta.name: Win the Mall
meta.description: Ten teams move into a mall where they must conquer storefronts, forge alliances and outsmart rivals to win $1 million in this reality competition series.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Ten teams enter the mall for a budget-busting shopping challenge to score their first stores. A face-off tests who can cram the biggest haul into a car.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Teams try to settle the score in a multi-layered fashion show hosted by a celebrity guest before the next closeout leaves two contestants hanging.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: While one team racks up wins, powers and influence, others scramble to secure more stores as a blind gift swap and rooftop exile cause tempers to flare.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A frantic race through the vents sends one team home and grants two others powerful protection before everyone faces a food-based memory test.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A high-stakes game of hide and seek with a celebrity creator leaves one team in a tight spot — and a closeout challenge swap reveals a hidden agenda.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The teams face a mystery box challenge and compete to mop up cash — and the competition. Later, a tricky timeline puzzle divides a top-tier alliance.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: With only four teams remaining, a surprise guest hosts a mannequin-smashing challenge for immunity. Later, a power card shakes up the competition.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: After going all in during a poker challenge, the finalists wage a trivia battle before a $1M shopping spree showdown decides who will win the mall.
